name: dodo Self-Hosted Reminders
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted recurring task and reminder scheduler with Telegram bot and browser notifications; no vendor-imposed software quota or subscription expiry.
watch_out: Requires your own Docker/server, SQLite storage and backups; Telegram notifications require a user-managed bot. Browser notifications require the web app to remain open and HTTPS/localhost; no hosted infrastructure is included. Designed for private Tailscale deployments.
